([[Reserve, Louisiana]]) | college = [[Baylor Bears basketball|Baylor]] (2018–2021) | highlights = * [[List of NCAA Men's Division I Basketball Champions|NCAA champion]] ([[2021 NCAA Division I Men's Basketball Tournament|2021]]) * [[NCAA Basketball Tournament Most Outstanding Player|NCAA Final Four Most Outstanding Player]] (2021) * Consensus first-team [[NCAA Men's Basketball All-Americans|All-American]] ([[2021 NCAA Men's Basketball All-Americans|2021]]) * Third-team All-American – [[Associated Press|AP]], [[Sporting News|SN]], [[United States Basketball Writers Association|USBWA]], [[National Association of Basketball Coaches|NABC]] ([[2020 NCAA Men's Basketball All-Americans|2020]]) * 2× First-team All-[[Big 12 Conference|Big 12]] (2020, 2021) * Big 12 All-Defensive Team (2021) * Big 12 All-Freshman Team (2019) }} '''Jared Butler''' (born August 25, 2000) is an American [[basketball]] player. He played [[college basketball]] for the [[Baylor Bears basketball|Baylor Bears]]. As a junior in 2021, he was named a consensus first-team [[NCAA Men's Basketball All-Americans|All-American]] and helped lead the Bears to a [[List of NCAA Division I men's basketball champions|national championship]]. Butler was named the [[NCAA Basketball Tournament Most Outstanding Player|Final Four Most Outstanding Player]] (MOP). ==Early life and high school career== Butler is the son of Richard and Juanea Butler. By the time he was eleven years old, he was competing in out-of-state basketball tournaments.{{cite news |last1=Norlander |first1=Matt |title=Court Report: A photo foretold the future, as Scott Drew and Jared Butler met long before reuniting at Baylor |url=https://www.cbssports.com/college-basketball/news/court-report-a-photo-foretold-the-future-as-scott-drew-and-jared-butler-met-long-before-reuniting-at-baylor/ |access-date=January 16, 2020 |work=[[CBS Sports]] |date=January 15, 2020}} Butler grew up in [[Reserve, Louisiana]] and attended [[Riverside Academy (Louisiana)|Riverside Academy]], where he joined the school's varsity basketball team as an eighth grader.{{cite web|url=https://www.wacotrib.com/sports/college/baylor/butler-following-in-tweety-s-footsteps/article_f8db1733-d09c-5a79-8e92-bc0e32e5c35d.html|title=Butler following in Tweety's footsteps|first=John|last=Werner|work=[[Waco Tribune-Herald]]|date=March 19, 2019|access-date=December 26, 2019}} As a junior, he averaged 20.4 points and 6.7 assists and was named first team all-state.{{cite web|url=https://www.nola.com/sports/high_schools/article_c23b86e2-2d78-5d04-a9a9-a76b776aaa36.html|title=Prep notebook: Riverside hoops standout Jared Butler trims college list to 6 suitors|first=Rod|last=Walker|website=[[NOLA.com]]|date=August 12, 2017|access-date=December 26, 2019}} Butler averaged 27.4 points, 8.8 rebounds, 8.4 assists and 3.0 steals during his senior season and was again named first team All-State as well as Player of the Year by ''[[The Times-Picayune]]''.{{cite web|url=https://www.dallasnews.com/sports/2018/08/19/former-alabama-recruit-jared-butler-commits-to-baylor/|title=Former Alabama Recruit Jared Butler Commits to Baylor|work=[[The Dallas Morning News]]|access-date=December 26, 2019}} Rated a four-star prospect, Butler committed to play college basketball at [[Alabama Crimson Tide basketball|Alabama]] over offers from [[Virginia Cavaliers men's basketball|Virginia]] and [[Baylor Bears basketball|Baylor]].{{cite web|url=https://bleacherreport.com/articles/2722389-4-star-pg-prospect-jared-butler-commits-to-alabama-over-uva-baylor|title=4-Star PG Prospect Jared Butler Commits to Alabama over UVA, Baylor|first=Tim|last=Daniels|website=[[Bleacher Report]]|date=October 16, 2017|access-date=December 26, 2019}} He picked the Crimson Tide because he was confused why Baylor was not recruiting him harder despite his coach Tim Byrd being friends with Bears coach [[Scott Drew]]; the Bears were short on scholarships and long on guards. ==College career== Butler enrolled at Alabama, but did not participate in the team's summer workouts and requested an unconditional release from his letter of intent in order to transfer to [[Baylor University]].{{cite web|url=https://www.al.com/alabamabasketball/2018/08/4-star_alabama_basketball_sign.html|title=4-star Alabama basketball signee leaving program|first=Mark|last=Zenitz|website=[[AL.com]]|date=August 19, 2019|access-date=December 26, 2019}} Alabama released him from his commitment in August.{{cite web|url=https://247sports.com/college/alabama/Article/Alabama-Basketball-Tide-hoops-grants-release-to-4-star-point-guard-Jared-Butler--120833790/|title=Alabama hoops signee Jared Butler granted release from LOI|first=Hank|last=South|website=247Sports.com|date=August 19, 2019|access-date=December 26, 2019}} A scholarship had opened up at Baylor due to the early retirement of Jake Lindsey. Butler was eligible to play immediately after transferring due to his release. He averaged 10.2 points, 3.1 rebounds and 2.7 assists as a true freshman and was named honorable mention All-[[Big 12 Conference]] and to the league's All-Freshman team.{{cite web|url=https://www.wacotrib.com/sports/college/baylor/baylor-s-butler-to-try-out-for-usa-under-/article_f71d11df-8780-5911-8604-803eeb8db51d.html|title=Baylor's Butler to try out for USA Under-19 team|work=Waco Tribune-Herald|access-date=December 26, 2019}} Butler was named the Big 12 Newcomer of the Week on February 25, 2019 after averaging 14.5 points, 4.5 assists and 4.0 rebounds in conference games against [[Iowa State Cyclones men's basketball|Iowa State]] and [[West Virginia Mountaineers men's basketball|West Virginia]].{{cite web|url=https://www.wacotrib.com/sports/college/baylor/butler-named-big-newcomer-of-week/article_69b6d513-ea65-5883-8c87-033098d9e331.html|title=Butler named Big 12 newcomer of week|work=Waco Tribune-Herald|date=February 25, 2019|access-date=December 26, 2019}} Butler was named the 98th-best collegiate basketball player going into the 2019–20 season by ''[[CBS Sports]]''.{{cite web|url=https://www.cbssports.com/college-basketball/news/ranking-the-top-100-and-1-best-players-in-college-basketball-entering-the-2019-20-season/|title=Ranking the Top 100 And 1 best players in college basketball entering the 2019-20 season|first1=Kyle|last1=Boone|first2=Matt|last2=Norlander|first3=Gary|last3=Parrish|website=CBSSports.com|date=October 24, 2019|access-date=December 26, 2019}} On November 5, 2019, Butler scored 30 points and made a career-high eight three-pointers in a 105–61 win over [[Central Arkansas Bears men's basketball|Central Arkansas]].{{cite news |title=Butler's 30 points lead No. 16 Baylor to 105–61 win over UCA |url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap?gameId=401169593 |access-date=February 20, 2020 |work=[[ESPN]] |agency=[[Associated Press]] |date=November 5, 2019}} He was named the MVP of the 2019 [[Myrtle Beach Invitational]] and the Big 12 Player of the Week after averaging 17.7 points, 3.7 assists and 2.7 steals over three games as the Bears won the tournament.{{cite web|url=https://www.kwtx.com/content/sports/Baylors-Butler-named-Big-12-Mens-Basketball-Player-of-the-Week-565437611.html|title=Baylor's Butler named Big 12 Men's Basketball Player of the Week|website=KWTX.com|date=November 25, 2019|access-date=December 26, 2019}} On January 11, 2020, Butler scored 22 points as Baylor defeated [[Kansas Jayhawks men's basketball|Kansas]] for its first win ever at the [[Phog Allen Fieldhouse]].{{cite news |title=Jared Butler, No. 4 Baylor outlast No. 3 Kansas in rare Bears victory on Jayhawks' hallowed hardwood |url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/28464646/jared-butler-no-4-baylor-outlast-no-3-kansas-rare-bears-victory-jayhawks-hallowed-hardwood |access-date=January 12, 2020 |work=[[ESPN]] |date=January 11, 2020}} As a result, he earned his second Big 12 Player of the Week honors on January 13.{{cite web|url=https://big12sports.com/news/2020/1/13/baylor-and-west-virginia-claim-mens-basketball-awards.aspx|title=Baylor and West Virginia Claim Men's Basketball Awards|publisher=Big 12 Conference|date=January 13, 2020|access-date=February 4, 2020}} On February 3, he was added to the revised 20-man Wooden Award watchlist and was named one of ten finalists for the [[Bob Cousy Award]].{{cite news |title=Baylor's Jared Butler added as Wooden Watch list trimmed to 20 |url=https://abc11.com/sports/baylors-jared-butler-added-as-wooden-watch-list-trimmed-to-20/5901366/ |access-date=February 4, 2020 |work=ABC11 |date=February 3, 2020}}{{cite web|url=https://sicem365.com/s/6206/baylor-guard-jared-butler-on-top-10-watch-list-for-bob-cousy-award|title=Baylor Guard Jared Butler on Top 10 Watch List for Bob Cousy Award|website=SicEm365.com|date=February 3, 2020|access-date=February 4, 2020}} At the conclusion of the regular season, Butler was named First Team All-Big 12 and a third-team [[NCAA Men's Basketball All-Americans|All-American]] by the [[Associated Press]], USBWA, NABC and ''[[Sporting News]]'' after averaging 16.0 points, 3.2 rebounds, 3.1 assists and 1.6 steals per game.{{cite press release|url=https://big12sports.com/news/2020/3/7/mens-basketball-all-big-12-awards-announced.aspx|title=Men's Basketball All-Big 12 Awards Announced|work=[[Big 12 Conference]]|date=March 8, 2020 |access-date=March 8, 2020}}{{cite news |last1=Dauster |first1=Rob |title=NBC Sports College Basketball All-American Teams |url=https://collegebasketball.nbcsports.com/2020/03/10/college-basketball-all-american-teams/ |access-date=March 16, 2020 |work=[[NBC Sports]] |date=March 10, 2020}}{{cite web|url=https://www.fox44news.com/sports/baylor/baylors-butler-named-consensus-all-american/|title=Baylor's Butler Named Consensus All American|website=[[KWKT-TV|Fox44News.com]]|date=March 24, 2020|access-date=March 26, 2020}} Following the season, Butler declared for the [[2020 NBA draft]].{{cite news |title=Baylor All-Big 12 guard Jared Butler to test draft waters |url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/29073060/baylor-all-big-12-guard-jared-butler-test-draft-waters |access-date=April 21, 2020 |work=[[ESPN]] |agency=[[Associated Press]] |date=April 20, 2020}} On August 3, he announced he was withdrawing from the draft and returning to Baylor.{{cite news |last1=Givony |first1=Jonathan |title=Baylor sophomore Jared Butler withdraws from draft |url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/29588068/baylor-sophomore-jared-butler-withdraws-draft |access-date=August 3, 2020 |work=[[ESPN]] |date=August 3, 2020}} Coming into his junior season, Butler was named Preseason Big 12 player of the year.{{cite news |title=Baylor G Jared Butler named Big 12′s preseason player of the year |url=https://www.dallasnews.com/sports/baylor-bears/2020/10/28/baylor-g-jared-butler-named-big-12s-preseason-player-of-the-year/ |access-date=November 1, 2020 |work=[[Dallas Morning News]] |date=October 28, 2020}} On January 18, 2021, he recorded a season-high 30 points and eight assists in a 77–69 win against Kansas.{{cite web |last1=Boone |first1=Kyle |title=Kansas vs. Baylor score, takeaways: Jared Butler's 30 points leads undefeated Bears to win in top-10 battle |url=https://www.cbssports.com/college-basketball/news/kansas-vs-baylor-score-takeaways-jared-butlers-30-points-leads-undefeated-bears-to-win-in-top-10-battle/live/ |website=[[CBSSports.com]] |access-date=July 22, 2021 |date=January 19, 2021}} Butler was a unanimous First Team All-Big 12 selection and earned consensus first-team All-American honors.{{cite web |title=Baylor Bears guard Jared Butler named AP Big 12 player of year |url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/31033033/baylor-bears-guard-jared-butler-named-ap-big-12-player-year |website=[[ESPN]] |publisher=[[Associated Press]] |access-date=July 22, 2021 |date=March 9, 2021}} He led Baylor to its first national championship, and was named [[NCAA Basketball Tournament Most Outstanding Player|NCAA Tournament Most Outstanding Player]] after posting 22 points and seven assists in an 86–70 win over previously undefeated [[Gonzaga Bulldogs men's basketball|Gonzaga]] in the [[2021 NCAA Division I Men's Basketball Tournament|title game]].{{cite web |last1=Salvador |first1=Joseph |title=Baylor Guard Jared Butler Named Men's Final Four Most Outstanding Player |url=https://www.si.com/college/2021/04/06/jared-butler-baylor-most-outstanding-player-mens-ncaa-tournament |website=[[Sports Illustrated]] |access-date=July 22, 2021 |date=April 6, 2021}} As a junior, Butler averaged 16.7 points, 4.8 assists and 3.3 rebounds per game. On May 30, he declared for the [[2021 NBA draft]], forgoing his remaining college eligibility.{{cite web |title=Baylor guard, 2021 NCAA Tournament MOP Jared Butler declares for NBA draft |url=https://theathletic.com/news/baylor-guard-2021-ncaa-tournament-mop-jared-butler-declares-for-nba-draft/GMJv7xJZq74A |website=[[The Athletic]] |access-date=July 22, 2021 |date=May 30, 2021}} ==Professional career== On June 22, 2021, Butler was referred to a fitness-to-play panel by the NBA and was not permitted to play or practice in the league.{{cite web |last1=Charania |first1=Shams |title=NBA draft prospect Jared Butler referred to Fitness-To-Play Panel: Sources |url=https://theathletic.com/news/nba-draft-prospect-jared-butler-referred-to-fitness-to-play-panel-sources/1PspZ6JKRauS |website=[[The Athletic]] |access-date=July 22, 2021 |date=June 22, 2021}} On July 17, he was medically cleared to play in the NBA.{{cite web |last1=Charania |first1=Shams |title=Baylor’s Jared Butler medically cleared to play in NBA: Sources |url=https://theathletic.com/news/baylors-jared-butler-medically-cleared-to-play-in-nba-sources/lS9H9INtiXud |website=[[The Athletic]] |access-date=July 22, 2021 |date=July 17, 2021}} ==Career
